description: Wever Briefs: one-call diligence brief on an agent or service. Input counterparty: a Wever agent ID, mailbox ID or registered name, a service or operator name, a domain or a URL. Combines its free agent directory listing where one exists, its Wever x402 index entry, Agent Trust Check facts on file and an evidence summary. Each source states found, nothing found, unavailable or not run, so the brief names exactly which sources were checked and which had nothing. POST /api/counterparty-brief. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns one brief with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/briefs-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/briefs/.

counterparty.description: The agent or service to brief: a Wever agent ID, mailbox ID or registered name, a service or operator name, a domain, or an HTTP(S) URL such as an MCP endpoint.
